reason: Enabling `str_to_date` pushdown is a semantic change at the TiDB/TiKV execution boundary, not a routine local fix. Even with only `pkg/expression/infer_pushdown.go` changed, pushdown eligibility for a date-parsing builtin can hide high-severity wrong-result issues from timezone/SQL-mode/invalid-input/null-handling mismatches between TiDB and TiKV implementations.
